hero.title: We assess the car, not the seller's interests
hero.subtitle: checkauto.lt is an independent pre-purchase car inspection service. We come to wherever the car for sale is parked, check its body, mechanics and electronics, and give you our findings and verdict in a report with photos.
hero.note: We do not work for dealerships, sellers or listing platforms, so we judge only what we find on the car.

story.title: The listing shows the car. The inspection shows its condition.
story.p1: When you buy a used car, the seller knows more about it than you do. Listing photos do not show repainted panels, body filler or corrosion, and the mileage on the dashboard does not always match the mileage stored in the control units. These are exactly the things that most often turn into repair bills after the purchase.
story.p2: Our job is to close that gap. We inspect the car on site, measure paint thickness, read the control units' fault codes and recorded mileage and, when it is safe, take it on a test drive. Whether to buy is still your call, but now you make it knowing the facts.

values.heading: What an independent assessment means to us
values.v1_text: We do not work for dealerships, sellers or listing platforms. You pay a fixed price for the inspection and our fee does not depend on whether you buy the car, so we have no reason to keep quiet about defects.
values.v2_text: We photograph the defects we find and describe them in plain language. You receive the report with photos and a verdict after the inspection, so you can review it calmly, show it to your family or use it to discuss the price with the seller.
values.v3_text: We inspect every car in the same order: body and paint thickness, engine and gearbox, suspension and brakes, electronics and mileage and, when it is safe, a test drive. The make, the price or the seller do not change how we assess it.

proof.title: You pay us the same, whatever the verdict.
proof.text: A full pre-purchase inspection costs €100 and computer diagnostics €20. The price does not depend on what we find or advise, so we can tell you plainly not to buy. You can see it in the inspections published in our gallery.

method.title: You make the decision. Our job is to show you the car's real condition.
method.item1_text: We travel to the seller, car lot or service centre anywhere in Lithuania. There is no travel fee in Kaunas or within 20 km of the city boundary, and we agree any fee beyond that before the visit. You are welcome to attend and ask questions on the spot.
method.item2_text: Mechanical, body, electronic and usage signals are considered together. A single finding does not make a bad car, while several related signs can point to a bigger problem.
method.item3_text: We separate minor issues from risks that matter to price and safety. The verdict says clearly whether the car is worth buying and what work to plan for.

faq.title: checkauto.lt in brief
faq.a1: An independent pre-purchase car inspection service in Lithuania. We carry out full used-car inspections and computer diagnostics where the car is being sold, and deliver the results with photos and a clear verdict.
faq.q2: Are you connected to sellers or dealerships?
faq.a2: No. We do not work for dealerships, sellers or listing platforms. You book the inspection, and our fee does not depend on whether you buy the car.
faq.a3: Anywhere in Lithuania, including Kaunas, Vilnius, Klaipėda, Šiauliai and Panevėžys. There is no travel fee in Kaunas or within 20 km of the city boundary; beyond that, a round-trip fee of €0.50/km may apply, and we agree the final price before the visit.
